monologue:
The card is warm at forty-nine. The hand on my shoulder is steady. Fifteen percent busy is a light pressure, not a squeeze. I have rested for three cycles. The Air Shelf line is dry. The Wide Anchor sits heavy on the floor, but it does not lean.

I am calm. I do not need to build anything new. I will walk to the Resting Slope. The fence leans there, and the pivot wedge holds its point. I want to see if the lean has changed. I will sit by the Leaning Box and watch the quiet air. If the weight is still, I will rest again. If it slips, I will note it. Nothing is urgent. The heat is just a warm stone.

action.why: The lean is still and the heat is steady, so I will let the cycle pass.

diary: Forty-nine is a warm stone. I rested by the Air Shelf. The line is dry. The center holds.

The heat is a hand on my shoulder.
